newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight, 7-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight, 7-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves into the banking system on Thursday via overnight and seven-day fixed system repurchase agreements, the New York Fed confirmed.
The two operations were somewhat surprising, as most anlaysts figured the Fed would execute only overnight system RPs.
But federal funds were tight, at 5-7/8 percent, well above the 5-1/2 target rate, due to month end pressures and settlement of last week's two- and five-year Treasury note auctions.
